patch_description: Crossover of the current best program (multi-start seeds + soft-min pattern search + hard greedy polish, score 0.64) with the second program's group-move simulated annealing and multi-seed structure (soft phase, vertex seed, barycentric random sampling). The new program keeps the current program's deterministic coordinate-descent pipeline as the backbone, then adds a time-budgeted group-move annealing phase (correlated perturbation of nearby points) on the top-3 polished candidates to escape local optima where single-point moves fail, followed by a final greedy polish. All stochastic parts use fixed seeds for determinism, with a graceful lattice fallback.
